name: Michigan
dueDateNotes: Michigan follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Michigan taxes your federal AGI at a flat 4.25% after a $5,900 personal exemption per person (2026).
uniqueFacts: Michigan has a flat 4.25% income tax and gives each person a $5,900 personal exemption for 2026.
Michigan only requires estimated payments if you expect to owe more than $500 in state tax for the year.
A few Michigan cities, including Detroit and Grand Rapids, add a separate local income tax that is not included here.
